verdict.rationale: The evidence never mentions training-data policies or an opt-out setting. The only related capability is that Aider can run fully against local models via Ollama or OpenAI-compatible local APIs. That keeps code and prompts off third-party model providers, which works as an indirect way to avoid training use rather than an explicit opt-out. Missing for 10: an explicit documented statement on training-data use or a no-training setting, guidance on provider-side training opt-outs when using hosted APIs, and independent corroboration.
